name: Dominik Žabčík
about: Engineer and CISO at NFCtron in Prague. I build payment software and keep it hard to break.
headline: Full-stack TypeScript engineer, CISO and Head of Development
profile: Backend-first engineer who leads development and security at NFCtron, a payment platform for live events, and at NFCtron Pay, which handles its card payments. I have worked across the chain: ticketing and payments in TypeScript and NestJS, bank payouts and invoicing, Android point-of-sale apps and a PCI MPoC-certified Tap to Pay terminal.

experience.title: CISO and Head of Development
experience.summary: I run engineering and own security across NFCtron and NFCtron Pay, its card payment platform.
highlights: Own security, risk, incident response and compliance with PCI and the card schemes; led PCI DSS 4.0.1, MPoC, scheme certifications and external pentests of our terminal.
Secure NFCtron Pay: Tap to Pay on Android, terminals, key management and its cloud.
Lead development of the platform: payments, ticketing, billing, bank payouts, point of sale and mobile apps.
Build NFCtron Nebula, our prepaid card program, with identity checks (KYC).
Bring AI agents into the team’s daily work, from internal assistants to coding agents.

experience.title: Core Backend Developer Lead
experience.summary: I led the core backend team and owned the architecture of its services.
highlights: Led the core backend team: planning, code review and mentoring.
Owned the architecture of the core services: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ on Kubernetes.
Worked on payment gateways, the ticket marketplace, PDF tickets and partner APIs.
Kept production stable and fast, with search on Typesense.

experience.title: Core Backend Developer
experience.summary: I joined to build the backend that payments at live events run on.
highlights: Built core backend services in TypeScript on NestJS, with PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and Typesense.
Worked on ticketing, refunds and bank payouts, reporting, fiscalization and the attendee app’s API.
Moved up to team lead after sixteen months.

projects.name: Snipr
projects.summary: A public page for links, browser-encrypted pastes and files, with analytics and mail on your own domain. Runs on Cloudflare Workers, with passkeys and billing. I own it and build it.

projects.name: Keyhop
projects.summary: Switches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and six more AI coding tools between accounts and tracks their usage.

projects.name: zabcik.me
projects.summary: My portfolio and interactive CV. A particle field spells each page, the homepage shows what I am listening to and pushing right now, and the CV renders itself to PDF in two languages.
